purpose: Seed the render server's QuartzCore binary archive with the recipes of its own default.metallib, so MTLPipelineOptionFailOnBinaryArchiveMiss creations stop being refused.
single_variable: The AdrenoMetal plugin executable. libvulkan_freedreno.dylib is byte-identical to the shipped one (cded9e66…); the kernel, menu, ADT, Data seed and Recovery wrapper are rebuilt from the same sources with only the embedded addon replaced.
change: NativeBridgeMetalFrontend.mm newBinaryArchiveWithDescriptor: now calls seedQuartzCoreArchive, which reads the archive URL as a Metal library, builds the 22 vert/frag recipes plus the two downsample_blur lpf/lph recipes the offline instrument bridge/quartzcore_cache.mm proves, and adds them with nmb_binary_archive_add_render. A file that is not a library changes nothing.
expected: QuartzCore's backdrop and blur pipelines (fixed_frag_lph_cph, narrow_blur_19_frag_lph, downsample_4_frag_lph, fixed_frag_lph_cpf) are created instead of refused, so the t970 cadence capture should contain no render pipeline BinaryArchiveMiss rows and the blur chain should compile once per process.

build.plugin_rebuild: SKIP_TURNIP_SELF_BIND=1 python3.14 scripts/build-adreno-metal-plugin.py --target ios --no-replay (host Turnip replay capture omitted; the shipped addon's Turnip is the same un-replayed build)

verification: codesign --verify --strict passes on the rebuilt bundle.
The rebuilt plugin executable contains the seeding log string and is 1360 bytes larger than the shipped one; libvulkan_freedreno.dylib hashes identical to the shipped copy.
The packed kernel's __t970_gpu_addon section equals the new addon plus its length word, asserted by pack.py.
The payload FAT carries the new trust cache (7 owner CDHashes) and the packer readback confirms it; ADT and Data seed are byte-identical to the base payload.
Command line is the same 994-byte line as cadence-b, still under the 1000-byte limit.
limits: Host result only until the image boots. Success is the absence of BinaryArchiveMiss rows in the t970 capture and a working blur chain; a wrong recipe set would instead show a bounded number of seeding failures in the log, and an archive this driver cannot read still opens empty, so the change cannot refuse a pipeline that used to succeed.
